description: Finished PV module attestation (stringing → lamination → framing → J-box → flash IV + EL imaging), emitted by the himawari module_assembly cell on the asher Murakumo node (composes kuni-umi Otete handling + Mimi metrology). Final link in the polysilicon lot → wafer batch → cell batch → module serial chain. G11 (deterministic provenance — flash IV + EL content-bound and per-module signed; serial ↔ feedstock lot traceable, never single-witness) + G4 (EPBT << module service life) + G12 (internal hikari install only, SBT↔SBT carve-out; NO external commercial PV sale) + G5 (design-for-recovery ≥90%) structural enforcement. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT) as canonical state; each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID, and per-serial history is queryable as-of any point. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200.

moduleSerial.description: stable per-module serial; leaf of the polysilicon lot → wafer batch → cell batch → module serial chain (G11 traceability) and the primary EAVT entity key for the module's Datom history

cellBatchId.description: G11: cell process batch this module's cells came from; chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.cellBatchRecord.batchId

feedstockLotId.description: G11/G2: feedstock lot the module is traceable to; chains back through waferBatchRecord to com.etzhayyim.himawari.polysiliconProvenanceAttestation.lotId (XUAR/forced-labor-exclusion provenance inherited from the lot). A module with no resolvable lot is never attestable (fail-closed).

recordedAt.description: module attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this serial

bomCid.description: G8: full module SBOM (CycloneDX → kotoba EAVT, ADR-2605312330); cells + glass + EVA/POE encapsulant + backsheet + frame + J-box, plus the consumed cell batch

ratedWp.description: nameplate rating (peak watts at STC; integer); flash-binning tolerance is evaluated against this

measuredWp.description: G11: Mimi flash-IV measured peak power (watts; integer). A module whose measured Wp deviates beyond ±5% (500 bps) of ratedWp is binned, never silently attested as in-spec.

flashIvCid.description: G11: content-addressed Mimi flash-IV curve (Isc / Voc / Pmax / FF / IV trace). Canonical-JSON sha256 CID; deterministic for identical measurements (cid:himawari:flashiv:sha256:...)

elImageCid.description: G11: content-addressed Mimi electroluminescence image (microcrack / finger-interruption / dark-cell inspection), bound into the per-module signature (cid:himawari:elimage:sha256:...)

thermalIrCid.description: optional: content-addressed Mimi thermal-IR hotspot scan; advisory metrology not load-bearing for the G11 signature

destinationActorDid.description: G12: install destination DID; MUST be an internal etzhayyim install actor (SBT↔SBT carve-out, currently did:web:etzhayyim.com:hikari). External / commercial destinations are refused outright — no external commercial PV sale, ever.

epbtMonths.description: G4: energy-payback-time (months; integer); must be << module service life with margin. Accumulates the renewable-only process energy from polysilicon → wafer → cell → module.

recyclabilityBps.description: G5: design-for-recovery in basis points 0-10000 (integer; 10000 = 100%). ≥9000 (≥90%) satisfies the circular floor; below-floor sets recyclabilityBelowFloor and is enforced at the silenHimawariReview Council gate.

recyclabilityBelowFloor.description: G5 advisory flag set when 0 < recyclabilityBps < 9000; surfaces to the Council circularity review without blocking the assembly cell

binned.description: G11: true when the module fell outside flash tolerance (or had no positive rated Wp). Binned modules are recorded for traceability but flagged, never passed off as in-spec.

binReason.description: human-readable reason a binned module was flagged (e.g. flash-power deviation in bps vs tolerance)

provenanceChainDigest.description: G11: sha256 digest over the canonical 'lot->cellBatch->serial' provenance link; binds the module record to its exact chain of custody (sha256:...)

attestingNode.description: Murakumo node that produced this attestation (module_assembly → asher per manifest.jsonld)

signature.description: G11: per-module provenance signature over the canonical signed-view bytes (serial + lot + both metrology CIDs + rating + BOM + destination + chain digest); reproducible by any verifier

attestingRobots.description: G11: Ed25519 robot witness quorum (>=2 distinct robots — at least one process + one metrology); deterministic provenance is never single-witness

moduleSignature.description: G11 per-module provenance signature. At R0 this is a deterministic content-binding (HMAC + sha256 over the canonical signed-view bytes) proving byte-integrity + non-substitution; at R1 activation the asher node's custody-held Ed25519 device key signs the SAME bytes (alg → 'ed25519') with the signedDigest contract unchanged. No server-held signing key lives in the cell (substrate boundary).

alg.description: signature algorithm; 'content-binding-sha256' at R0 → 'ed25519' at R1 activation

signedDigest.description: sha256 over (domain tag || canonical signed-view bytes); reproducible by any verifier from the public record fields (sha256:...)

binding.description: HMAC content-binding over the canonical signed-view bytes (placeholder for the Ed25519 signature at R1)

signer.description: Murakumo node identity of the signer (asher)

serverHeldKey.description: substrate-boundary invariant: MUST be false — no signing key is ever held in-cell or server-side

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human QA tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

role.description: witness role (e.g. stringing / lamination / framing / flash-iv / el-imaging / metrology)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested module bundle
